problem_statement: 8 of 63 pilot courts in NTB (2/14) and Jawa Barat (6/49) carry legacy addresses flagged pending_verification in P03 DS02.
evidence_summary: P03 P1 court registry (ds02_pilot_courts_ntb_jabar.json) + court_institution_crosswalk.csv (76/76 reconciled).
affected_population: Rural and peri-urban court users in NTB (52) and Jawa Barat (32).
legal_basis: UU No. 14 Tahun 2008 (Keterbukaan Informasi Publik); SK KMA tentang Standar Pelayanan Informasi Publik di Pengadilan.
institutional_competence: Mahkamah Agung RI / Satuan Kerja Pengadilan Negeri & Pengadilan Agama (advisory proposal; no institutional representation).
policy_option: Publish verified satker address and service-channel updates synchronized with Master Court Registry IDs.
implementation_requirements: Cross-check 8 flagged satkers against official court websites and SIPP.
resource_assumptions: Low-cost administrative verification using existing satker directories.
risks: Stale physical location data misdirecting rural litigants.
expected_outputs: 100% verified address status across all 63 NTB & Jawa Barat pilot courts.
expected_outcomes: Reduced navigation friction for rural court users (proposition to test).

problem_statement: Accredited legal aid (OBH) capacity in pilot provinces is concentrated in Grade C (32/55) with only 5 Grade A providers across NTB and Jawa Barat.
evidence_summary: P03 P1 BPHN OBH dataset (ds05_pilot_obh_ntb_jabar.json, n=55: Grade C=32, B=18, A=5).
affected_population: Low-income and rural communities in NTB (52) and Jawa Barat (32).
legal_basis: UU No. 16 Tahun 2011 tentang Bantuan Hukum; PP No. 42 Tahun 2013.
institutional_competence: BPHN (Kementerian Hukum) and Provincial Legal Aid Committees (advisory proposal only).
policy_option: Prioritize P06 Last Mile paralegal and offline legal-knowledge partnerships in districts with zero or Grade-C-only OBH coverage.
implementation_requirements: District-level OBH-to-population ratio validation and P06 pilot design.
resource_assumptions: Leverages existing BPHN-accredited OBH network and village paralegal desks.
risks: Uneven geographic distribution within provinces not captured by province totals.
expected_outputs: District-level OBH gap map integrated with Kemendesa Indeks Desa 2025.
expected_outcomes: Improved legal aid reachability in underserved rural districts (proposition to test).

problem_statement: 3 of 14 legal provisions in P05 interim datasets were flagged CONFLICT_FLAGGED or UNVERIFIED during Gate 3/6 legal review.
evidence_summary: P05 Legal & Accessibility Review (reports/p05-legal-accessibility-review.md): 11/14 provisions verified; 3 excluded.
affected_population: General public, UMKM, and workers relying on plain-language legal guides.
legal_basis: UU No. 12 Tahun 2011 tentang Pembentukan Peraturan Perundang-undangan (as amended).
institutional_competence: Independent Observatory Legal Verification Agent + Human Legal Reviewer (Gate 6).
policy_option: Enforce mandatory primary-source re-verification against peraturan.bpk.go.id and jdihn.go.id before any plain-language guide publication.
implementation_requirements: Human legal sign-off on the 3 excluded provisions.
resource_assumptions: Zero external budget; internal legal review workflow.
risks: Publishing outdated or repealed statutory references.
expected_outputs: Zero unverified provisions in P1 public knowledge releases.
expected_outcomes: Higher reliability and public trust in plain-language legal resources.
evaluation_method: Automated provenance check + human legal audit log.
